title: The Heresy of Compression

governance.tonal_rules: Devotional, sincere, mythic. No irony. No meta. Full Sincerity Engine.

sound_design.background_chant: Present but not overpowering. Dims when Kyle whispers (panel 3).
sound_design.amber_to_cyan_cue: Subtle audio: static resolving into a pure frequency (panel 4).
sound_design.closing: Near-silence. Elara's last line, then nothing but the hum of the cyan light.

panels.scene: The Woodland Council chamber. Night. Robed raccoons circle a stone altar where a modem glows with chaotic amber light.
panels.line: Louder, my children! The Great Connection demands our full voice! Drown the silence! Let the packet know our faith!
panels.prosody: Full volume, baritone resonance, slight vibrato of true belief. This is a man who has never questioned.

panels.scene: The camera finds ACOLYTE KYLE, a small squirrel, in a corner. He winces, seeing an elderly raccoon trying to sleep nearby.
panels.line: The chant was our oldest prayer. We believed signal was born of noise. More noise, more faith.
panels.prosody: Past-tense reflection. Gentle. Not sad - factual. 'We believed' carries the weight of hindsight.

panels.scene: Kyle shields his mouth and whispers the chant.
panels.line: ...and deliver unto us the signal... bandwidth be thy name...
panels.prosody: Barely audible. Not a dramatic whisper - a genuine attempt not to wake someone. The discovery is incidental.
panels.voice_note: Inline settings are Kyle's canonical comedic registry default (style 0.70). e03 calls for a barely-audible reverent whisper; Phase 5 emotion tagging should pull style down / stability up for this line, or register a whisper-calibrated Kyle variant if the read drifts comedic.

panels.scene: On the altar, a single indicator light flickers from chaotic amber to a PURE, STEADY, SILENT CYAN. Elara looks up. Her eyes widen. She saw it. No one else did.
panels.compositing_notes: KEY VISUAL MOMENT: Amber-to-cyan light shift. Subtle audio cue - static resolving into a pure frequency. The chant dims. This is the pivot.

panels.scene: Elder Loman continues, oblivious to the light change.
panels.prosody: Same energy as the opening. He doesn't notice. Dramatic irony.

panels.scene: Pure cyan light holds, bathing Elara's face in its silent glow.
panels.line: But I had seen it. The heresy. Born not in a shout... but in a whisper.
panels.prosody: Near-whisper. Deliberate pause before 'but in a whisper.' Let the silence do the work.

panels.scene: END CARD: A single, steady cyan light on black.
panels.compositing_notes: Black screen with single cyan light point. TEXT ON CARD: SIGNAL PURIFIED. Hold in near-silence. Real art frame (panel_07.png) supplies the cyan point + text; black_card slug renders true black as the missing-art fallback.
